_comment: Chapter 4 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F20, a rescue: the archer scout (the village: Grey Mask's trail; the name "Bran").

text.zh_TW: 王都的弓箭斥候躲在岩縫裡，箭袋已經空了。「你就是那個發光的孩子？我在跟蹤灰面——他往上去了，還一直在找一個叫『布蘭』的名字……不，是他在躲這個名字。」
text.en: An archer scout from the capital hides in a crack in the rock, quiver empty. "You're the glowing kid? I've been tailing Grey Mask. He went up... and he keeps flinching at a name. 'Bran'."

label.en: "Come back to the village with me first."

text.zh_TW: 斥候：「好。回去我把看到的都告訴你。」
text.en: Scout: "Fine. I'll tell you everything I saw when we're back."
